title: Default SNMP community (community) — review required
description: SNMP runs with a default community string: community public. Defaults are the first guess in every scan and grant the configured MIB view. This lexical rule flags the default; the reviewer confirms necessity or replaces it.
remediation: Set a strong community (a random community or SNMPv3) or move to SNMPv3 with authPriv.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the default regardless of ACLs.
